product_metadata.title: EaZy MealZ Bacon Rack & Tray Set | Specialty Tray and Grease Catcher | Even Cooking | Non-Stick | Healthy Cooking Material | Customized Cooking Experience (Medium, Gray)
features: Batch Cooking: Our bacon rack is designed to accommodate up to 12 strips of bacon and features a convenient grease-catching tray.

Even Heat: An essential tool for achieving perfectly cooked, crispy bacon. Its unique design separates each strip of bacon, allowing for ideal heat circulation and even cooking. Don't settle for less-than-perfect bacon - upgrade your breakfast game with our high-quality bacon rack today.

Bottom Tray: Our innovative design is specifically engineered to catch all the excess oil from your food, resulting in a cleaner, healthier meal; Enjoy your favorite fried foods without the guilt of excess fat.
Nonstick Coating: Enjoy our nonstick coated rack and tray; Our products are designed with your health in mind, using only safe, quality materials for a worry-free cooking experience.
Dual Use: With its flat surface and sturdy construction, the tray is perfect for baking everything from cookies to roasted vegetables.
Product Dimensions: This product measures 14" x 9"; Please measure your air fryer or oven to ensure it will fit properly.
